title: Tell us what broke
lead: Something not working in the garden planner? Say what you tapped and what happened instead.
short_text: ="A little more, please: " & TEXT(need) & IF(need = 1, " more character", " more characters")
note: Leave out passwords and home addresses. A report holds your words and the topic, nothing else.
sent_line: =IF(last_topic = "", "Thanks. That makes ", "Thanks, filed under " & last_topic & ". That makes ") & TEXT(sent_count) & IF(sent_count = 1, " report", " reports") & " from you."
